card.name: Digits inside years and dates
card.fires_on: A single digit in the middle of a multi-digit year or number, such as the 6 in 4,600 or the 5 in 1954. It appears in historical or landmark descriptions, often about monuments and old structures.

modes.label: Digit inside a year
modes.description: The third or fourth digit of a year, especially in dates for buildings, sites or artifacts.
modes.example: designated a UNESCO World Heritage site in 19<<7>>9

modes.label: Digit inside an age or size
modes.description: A digit within a large number giving an age or weight.
modes.example: The world's oldest trees are 4,<<6>>00 year old Bristlecone

card.writes: It pushes up number-like and growth words and pushes down statue and monument words, so it adds little clear output.
card.plain: It fires on a middle digit of a year or large number in passages about old landmarks and artifacts.
